The '''lecture hall''' in the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was used to instruct the [[Padawan/Legends|students]] at the [[Jedi academy|academy]], and was located behind a hedge of [[bambwood]] at the end of the [[Crooked Way]]. It was a large building with a steeply pitched roof, inside of which was a simple but soaring auditorium with pillars of pale wood designed to hold 2,000 people. At the eastern side of the building was the [[Jedi Master/Legends|instructor's]] door that led into a short, wood-floored hallway, at the end of which was a sliding panel located behind the dais. At the entrance of the building was the lecture hall's small library.<ref name="DN III" />

It was here in [[36 ABY]], that [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] brought together nearly every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]] for the [[Conclave on Ossus|convocation]] where he officially took the position of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]].<ref name="DN III" />
